invariants.rationale: The method expects a list of records on which to perform an upsert. Null records could cause NullPointerExceptions.
instantTime is used for time-stamping the write operation, and must not be null for correct processing.
instantTime should be a valid timestamp string, so it should not be empty.
The logic of upsert assumes there are no null elements in the input records list.
List size is always non-negative in Java.
